1.outline: Term theme: 'Data & Coding Fun'. Run a quick TypingClub accuracy check and set a final-term goal.
objectives: Complete a timed typing check.
Compare today's accuracy with earlier in the year.
Set a final typing goal for the year.

plan.title: Accuracy check
plan.detail: Run one timed TypingClub exercise and record the accuracy score.

plan.title: Compare progress
plan.detail: Compare today's score with the Term 1 and Term 2 scores on the tracker.

plan.title: Set a final goal
plan.detail: Write one typing goal for the rest of the year.

plan.title: Log out
plan.detail: Log out.

successCriteria: I completed a timed typing check.
I compared my progress across the year.
I set a typing goal for the rest of the year.

2.subtopic: Run a Class Survey on Paper
2.outline: Run a simple class survey (favourite colour, fruit or sport) and record results using tally marks on paper.
2.sowResources: Paper tally sheets, survey question cards.
objectives: Ask a survey question to classmates.
Record answers using tally marks.
Total each tally group correctly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Tally marks demo
plan.detail: Show how to make groups of five with tally marks.

plan.title: Run the survey
plan.detail: Ask classmates the survey question and record answers with tally marks.

plan.title: Total it
plan.detail: Total each tally group. Log out.

successCriteria: I asked the survey question to several classmates.
I recorded answers using tally marks.
I totalled each group correctly.

3.outline: Enter the tallied survey data into Sheets or Excel and build a simple pictogram to show the results visually.
3.sowResources: Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, pictogram exemplar.
objectives: Enter tallied data into a spreadsheet.
Build a pictogram from the data.
Check the pictogram matches the tally totals.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Enter the data
plan.detail: Type the tally totals into a spreadsheet with clear headings.

plan.title: Build the pictogram
plan.detail: Use the data to build a simple pictogram chart.

plan.title: Match check
plan.detail: Check the pictogram matches the paper tally totals. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My data is entered with clear headings.
My pictogram is built from the data.
My pictogram matches the tally totals.

4.subtopic: Who Has the Most? The Least?
4.outline: Read the pictogram to answer questions: which answer got the most votes, which got the least, and by how much.
objectives: Identify the highest and lowest values in the pictogram.
Calculate the difference between them.
Write one sentence describing the data.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Reading the pictogram
plan.detail: Ask questions: which is highest, which is lowest, what's the difference?

plan.title: Write it up
plan.detail: Write one sentence describing what the pictogram shows.

plan.title: Partner check
plan.detail: Partner checks the sentence matches the pictogram. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I identified the highest and lowest values.
I calculated the difference between them.
I wrote a sentence describing the data correctly.

5.outline: Open Scratch and use a repeat block to make a character perform a repeating dance move.
objectives: Open Scratch and choose a sprite.
Use a repeat block to loop a movement.
Test and adjust the loop count.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Scratch tour
plan.detail: Show the Scratch interface: sprite, stage, block palette, green flag.

plan.title: Build a dance loop
plan.detail: Use a repeat block to make the sprite move and turn in a repeating pattern.

plan.title: Adjust it
plan.detail: Change the repeat count and see the effect. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I opened Scratch and chose a sprite.
My sprite dances in a repeating loop.
I changed the loop count and saw the effect.

6.outline: Learn the 'when this sprite clicked' event block so tapping a character makes something happen.
objectives: Use a 'when sprite clicked' event block.
Make something happen when the sprite is clicked.
Explain what an event is.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: What is an event?
plan.detail: An event is something that triggers the program — like a doorbell.

plan.title: Build a click event
plan.detail: Add 'when this sprite clicked' and a sound or costume change block underneath.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Click the sprite and check it responds. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I used a 'when sprite clicked' block.
My sprite responds when clicked.
I can explain what an event is.

7.outline: Swap Scratch projects with a partner and find and fix the bug in their broken script.
objectives: Read a partner's Scratch script to find the bug.
Fix the bug without breaking anything else.
Explain the fix to the partner.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Prepare a bug
plan.detail: Deliberately introduce one small bug into your own project for a partner to find.

plan.title: Swap and fix
plan.detail: Swap projects, find the bug, and fix it.

plan.title: Explain the fix
plan.detail: Explain to the original owner what was wrong and how it was fixed. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I found the bug in a partner's project.
I fixed the bug without breaking anything else.
I explained the fix clearly.

8.subtopic: Save and Share the Best Projects
8.outline: Save the finished Scratch projects and share the best ones with the class.
objectives: Save a finished Scratch project.
Share the project with the class.
Give one kind comment about a classmate's project.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Showcase
plan.detail: Groups share their favourite finished project on the projector.

plan.title: Kind comments
plan.detail: Each pupil gives one kind, specific comment.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the finished project to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I saved my finished Scratch project.
I shared it with the class.
I gave a kind, specific comment to a classmate.

9.outline: Recap this term's skills: tallying, pictograms, loops and events, through a quick station rotation.
objectives: Recap tallying, pictograms, loops and events.
Complete each station task.
Identify which skill needs more practice.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Station 1 — Data
plan.detail: Read a pictogram and answer a question about it.

plan.title: Station 2 — Loop
plan.detail: Build a short repeating loop in Scratch.

plan.title: Station 3 — Event
plan.detail: Add a click event to a starter project.

plan.title: Reflect
plan.detail: Name the trickiest skill. Log out.

successCriteria: I completed all three stations.
I can recap this term's data and coding skills.
I know which skill needs more practice.

10.outline: Rehearse the practical task in pairs: build a pictogram from data, and a Scratch loop, checking for bugs.
objectives: Rehearse building a pictogram and a loop with a partner.
Check both for accuracy and bugs.
Explain both pieces of work.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build a small pictogram and a Scratch loop with a partner reading the task card.

plan.title: Explain both
plan.detail: Explain the pictogram and the loop to the partner. Log out.

successCriteria: I rehearsed building a pictogram and a loop with a partner.
I checked both for accuracy and bugs.
I explained both pieces of work.

11.outline: Individual task: build a pictogram that matches the data, plus a Scratch project using a working loop.
objectives: Build a pictogram that matches given data.
Build a Scratch project using a working loop.
Explain both pieces of work briefly.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Pictogram task
plan.detail: Individual practical: build a pictogram from given data.

plan.title: Scratch task
plan.detail: Build a Scratch project using a working loop.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My pictogram matches the given data.
My Scratch project uses a working loop.
I explained both pieces of work.

12.outline: Plan a bigger final project: a Scratch 'data story' that presents the term's survey results with an animated character.
objectives: Plan a Scratch project that presents survey results.
Decide what the animated character will say about the data.
Sketch the plan on paper.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Plan the show
plan.detail: Sketch how the character will present the survey results, using loops and events from this term.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan shows how the character presents the data.
My plan uses ideas from this term (loops, events).
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.outline: Build the Scratch data story following the plan, combining loops, events and the survey pictogram data.
objectives: Build the character's data presentation.
Use a loop and an event block.
Test the finished sequence.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the show
plan.detail: Follow the plan to build the character's presentation using loops and events.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Test the whole sequence and fix anything that doesn't work. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My show presents the survey data.
My show uses a loop and an event block.
I tested my show and fixed any bugs.

14.outline: Add one polish touch — a second character, extra sound, or background — and rehearse presenting the finished data story.
objectives: Add one polish feature to the show.
Rehearse presenting it.
Save the finished project.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add polish
plan.detail: Add a background, extra sound or second character.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise presenting the show to a partner.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the finished project. Log out.

successCriteria: My show has one polish feature.
I rehearsed presenting it to a partner.
My finished project is saved.

15.outline: Present the finished Class Survey Show to the class, sharing what the survey found, and save the year's portfolio.
objectives: Present the finished data story confidently.
Share the survey's findings with an audience.
Save the whole year's portfolio.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Data Story Fair
plan.detail: Present the Scratch shows to the class in small groups.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished project and review the whole year's portfolio folder.

plan.title: Year celebration
plan.detail: Name three things learned this year. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my data story confidently.
I shared the survey's findings with an audience.
My whole year's work is saved in the portfolio.
